name: Unvisited ground near Mount Washburn
science_question: This easy ground (about 3° slope) lies next to the Mount Washburn boulder field, whose boulders include types never seen before on Mars. Do such boulders lie here too?
tasks: Walk to the target area and photograph it from about 5 m.
Look for light-toned, speckled boulders like Atoko Point among the darker ones and photograph any you find.
Photograph one boulder up close with a scale bar.
